thread:
maya: quick heads-up — deploying lite-encoder v1.2 to 10% of traffic for us-west tonight at 22:00 UTC. low-risk config tweak only, no DB migrations. expecting ~5-10% extra mem on handful of pods. :eyes:
liam: noted, I'll be on watcher duty 21:50–23:30 UTC. ping me if p95 spikes.+1
jordan: I'll cover first response if anything odd shows up in traces. are we gating by error rate or latency?
maya: primary gate = error rate > 1% over 5m OR tail latency p95 increase > 30% vs baseline. fallback = toggle feature flag and scale down canary pods.
sam: can you paste the rollback toggle cmd (for runbook)? want it in the ops pager message.
maya: sure — curl snippet below. it's idempotent.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"lite-encoder","state":"off","scope":"us-west"}'
```

maya: also will run `kubectl rollout status` on deployment/lite-encoder-canary and monitor `container_memory_rss_bytes` in prometheus.
rebecca: infra note — autoscaler has a cool-down of 3m; if memory climbs we'll need to manually scale up before relying on autoscaling. ops-sre already tagged the runbook.
ops-bot: Scheduled: lite-encoder v1.2 canary start @ 2432109600 (22:00 UTC). Watchers: liam, jordan. Reminders: 10m before, at start, and 15m post-start.
liam: got the reminder. I'll create a quick dashboard watch list (p95 latency, error rate, mem rss, pod restarts) and link it here in 10m.
jordan: I'll keep an eye on trace sampling and tail logs. if we see repeated OOM/killing, plan to toggle and scale down to previous replica count.
sam: confirming rollback playbook steps are: 1) toggle flag off 2) `kubectl rollout undo` to previous replicaset 3) scale replicas to baseline and clear canary traffic 4) open incident if automated rollback fails. ok?
maya: yup — that's the plan. I'll post the exact commands in the runbook channel and attach to this thread.
rebecca: FYI — no schema changes, but lb config will shift ~10% traffic; downstream feature-rerouter should handle it. we're good on infra ACLs.
liam: linking dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/lite-encoder-canary-watch?orgId=1 (p95, errors, mem, restarts)
maya: tiny risk: we saw a non-deterministic mem bump in staging under long-context inputs. mitigation: applying a temporary request-size cap to canary (max_tokens=1024). if we see same pattern, we'll tighten cap and roll back.
jordan: noted — will watch for token size logs.
ops-bot: Reminder: freeze window for this release = none (config-only) but no unrelated deploys to inference clusters 21:45–23:30 UTC.
sam: tagging product: @product if you want to delay or stop the canary for customer-facing reasons.
maya: thanks all — I will start deploy at 22:00, update status here at start, +15m, and when fully rolled back or promoted. feel free to DM for urgent issues. :thumbsup:
